SELECT CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID, CDDH.TRANSACTION_ID, CDDH.DEDUCTION_DATE, CDDH.DEDUCTION_TYPE, CDDH.DEPOSIT_STATUS, CDDH.CONTRACT_ID, CDDH.DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY, CDDH.BP_ID, nvl(nvl(CDDH.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT,CDD.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM),0) DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM, nvl(CDD.DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM,0) DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM, nvl(CDD.DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM,0) DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM, DTYPE.MEANING DEDUCTION_TYPE_DESC, DSTATUS.MEANING DEPOSIT_STATUS_DESC FROM (SELECT H.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID, H.TRANSACTION_ID, H.DEDUCTION_DATE, H.DEDUCTION_TYPE, H.DEPOSIT_STATUS, H.CONTRACT_ID, H.DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY, H.BP_ID, NULL DEDUCTION_AMOUNT FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD H UNION SELECT R.DEPOSIT_REFUND_ID, R.TRANSACTION_ID, R.REFUND_DATE, R.REFUND_TYPE, R.REFUND_STATUS, R.CONTRACT_ID, R.REFUND_DOC_CATEGORY, R.BP_ID, R.REFUND_AMOUNT FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_REFUND R) CDDH JOIN DTYPE ON DTYPE.CODE = 'CSH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_TYPE' AND DTYPE.CODE_VALUE = CDDH.DEDUCTION_TYPE JOIN DSTATUS ON DSTATUS.CODE = 'CSH.DEPOSIT_STATUS' AND DSTATUS.CODE_VALUE = CDDH.DEPOSIT_STATUS LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT) DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_INTEREST) DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL) DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION C GROUP BY C.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID ) CDD ON CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=CDD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID WHERE 1=1
AND CDDH.TRANSACTION_ID=#{transactionId}

SELECT CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID, CDDH.TRANSACTION_ID, CDDH.DEDUCTION_DATE, CDDH.DEDUCTION_TYPE, CDDH.DEPOSIT_STATUS, CDDH.CONTRACT_ID, CDDH.DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY, CDDH.BP_ID, CDDH.CREATION_DATE, nvl(CDD.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM,0) DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM, nvl(CDD.DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM,0) DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM, nvl(CDD.DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM,0) DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM, CT.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, nvl(CT.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,0) WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, CT.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT-nvl(CT.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CON.LEFT_AMOUNT,0) LEFT_AMOUNT, nvl((SELECT SUM(D.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT) FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION D , CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD HD WHERE HD.TRANSACTION_ID=CT.TRANSACTION_ID AND D.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=HD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID AND HD.DEPOSIT_STATUS IN('NEW','APPROVED_RETURN','APPROVING','REJECTED')),0) + nvl((SELECT SUM(R.REFUND_AMOUNT) FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_REFUND R WHERE R.TRANSACTION_ID=CT.TRANSACTION_ID AND R.REFUND_STATUS!='APPROVED'),0) PRE_OCCUPY_AMOUNT, nvl((SELECT SUM(D.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT) FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION D , CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION HD WHERE HD.TRANSACTION_ID=CT.TRANSACTION_ID AND D.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=HD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID AND HD.DEPOSIT_STATUS IN('NEW','APPROVED_RETURN','APPROVING','REJECTED') AND HD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID!=#{depositDeductionHdId}),0) + nvl((SELECT SUM(R.REFUND_AMOUNT) FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_REFUND R WHERE R.TRANSACTION_ID=CT.TRANSACTION_ID AND R.REFUND_STATUS!='APPROVED'),0) OTHER_OCCUPY_AMOUNT FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD CDDH JOIN CSH_TRANSACTION CT ON CT.TRANSACTION_ID=CDDH.TRANSACTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT) DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_INTEREST) DEDUCTION_INTEREST_SUM, SUM(C.DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL) DEDUCTION_PRINCIPAL_SUM FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION C GROUP BY C.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID ) CDD ON CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=CDD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, 'FCT_CONTRACT' DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY, nvl(SUM(FQC.DUE_AMOUNT),0)-nvl(SUM(FQC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT),0) LEFT_AMOUNT FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=FQC.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM=14 GROUP BY FC.CONTRACT_ID UNION SELECT CC.CONTRACT_ID, 'CON_CONTRACT' DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY, nvl(SUM(CQC.DUE_AMOUNT),0)-nvl(SUM(CQC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT),0) LEFT_AMOUNT FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CQC ON CC.CONTRACT_ID=CQC.CONTRACT_ID AND CQC.CF_ITEM=14 GROUP BY CC.CONTRACT_ID ) CON ON CDDH.DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY=CON.DEDUCTION_DOC_CATEGORY AND CDDH.CONTRACT_ID=CON.CONTRACT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=#{depositDeductionHdId}
